constants.name: xl24HourClock
constants.description: True if you are using 24-hour time; False if you are using 12-hour time.

constants.name: xl4DigitYears
constants.description: True if you are using four-digit years; False if you are using two-digit years.

constants.name: xlAlternateArraySeparator
constants.description: Alternate array item separator to be used if the current array separator is the same as the decimal separator.

constants.name: xlColumnSeparator
constants.description: Character used to separate columns in array literals.

constants.name: xlCountryCode
constants.description: Country/Region version of Microsoft Excel.

constants.name: xlCountrySetting
constants.description: Current country/region setting in the Windows Control Panel.

constants.name: xlCurrencyBefore
constants.description: True if the currency symbol precedes the currency values; False if it follows them.

constants.name: xlCurrencyCode
constants.description: Currency symbol.

constants.name: xlCurrencyDigits
constants.description: Number of decimal digits to be used in currency formats.

constants.name: xlCurrencyLeadingZeros
constants.description: True if leading zeros are displayed for zero currency values.

constants.name: xlCurrencyMinusSign
constants.description: True if you are using a minus sign for negative numbers; False if you are using parentheses.

constants.name: xlCurrencyNegative
constants.description: Currency format for negative currency values: 0 = (symbolx) or (xsymbol), 1 = -symbolx or -xsymbol, 2 = symbol-x or x-symbol, or 3 = symbolx- or xsymbol-, where symbol is the currency symbol of the country or region. Note that the position of the currency symbol is determined by xlCurrencyBefore.

constants.name: xlCurrencySpaceBefore
constants.description: True if a space is added before the currency symbol.

constants.name: xlCurrencyTrailingZeros
constants.description: True if trailing zeros are displayed for zero currency values.

constants.name: xlDateOrder
constants.description: Order of date elements: 0 = month-day-year, 1 = day-month-year, 2 = year-month-day

constants.name: xlDateSeparator
constants.description: Date separator (/).

constants.name: xlDayCode
constants.description: Day symbol (d).

constants.name: xlDayLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in days.

constants.name: xlDecimalSeparator
constants.description: Decimal separator.

constants.name: xlGeneralFormatName
constants.description: Name of the General number format.

constants.name: xlHourCode
constants.description: Hour symbol (h).

constants.name: xlLeftBrace
constants.description: Character used instead of the left brace ({) in array literals.

constants.name: xlLeftBracket
constants.description: Character used instead of the left bracket ([) in R1C1-style relative references.

constants.name: xlListSeparator
constants.description: List separator.

constants.name: xlLowerCaseColumnLetter
constants.description: Lowercase column letter.

constants.name: xlLowerCaseRowLetter
constants.description: Lowercase row letter.

constants.name: xlMDY
constants.description: True if the date order is month-day-year for dates displayed in the long form; False if the date order is day-month-year.

constants.name: xlMetric
constants.description: True if you are using the metric system; False if you are using the English measurement system.

constants.name: xlMinuteCode
constants.description: Minute symbol (m).

constants.name: xlMonthCode
constants.description: Month symbol (m).

constants.name: xlMonthLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in months (when months are displayed as numbers).

constants.name: xlMonthNameChars
constants.description: Always returns three characters for backward compatibility. Abbreviated month names are read from Microsoft Windows and can be any length.

constants.name: xlNoncurrencyDigits
constants.description: Number of decimal digits to be used in noncurrency formats.

constants.name: xlNonEnglishFunctions
constants.description: True if you are not displaying functions in English.

constants.name: xlRightBrace
constants.description: Character used instead of the right brace (}) in array literals.

constants.name: xlRightBracket
constants.description: Character used instead of the right bracket (]) in R1C1-style references.

constants.name: xlRowSeparator
constants.description: Character used to separate rows in array literals.

constants.name: xlSecondCode
constants.description: Second symbol (s).

constants.name: xlThousandsSeparator
constants.description: Zero or thousands separator.

constants.name: xlTimeLeadingZero
constants.description: True if a leading zero is displayed in times.

constants.name: xlTimeSeparator
constants.description: Time separator (:).

constants.name: xlUpperCaseColumnLetter
constants.description: Uppercase column letter.

constants.name: xlUpperCaseRowLetter
constants.description: Uppercase row letter (for R1C1-style references).

constants.name: xlWeekdayNameChars
constants.description: Always returns three characters for backward compatibility. Abbreviated weekday names are read from Microsoft Windows and can be any length.

constants.name: xlYearCode
constants.description: Year symbol in number formats (y).
